pages.title: Home
pages.description: Landing page and authenticated user dashboard with convention day overview.

pages.title: Login
pages.description: Sign in to your volunteer account.

pages.title: Create Profile
pages.description: Register as a new volunteer for the Albany JW Regional Convention parking team.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.description: How your personal data is collected, stored, and used on this platform.

pages.title: Terms of Service
pages.description: Terms and conditions governing use of this platform.

pages.title: Site Map
pages.description: Full index of all pages available on this platform, filtered to your access level.

pages.title: Maps
pages.description: Convention parking maps, pedestrian routes, sign placement guides, and other reference materials.

pages.title: Schedules
pages.description: Published convention day shift schedules for all departments.

pages.title: Sign Library
pages.description: Browse sign templates and their placements around the convention area.

pages.title: Sign Builder
pages.description: Create and edit reusable sign templates with text and arrow direction.

pages.title: Sign Map
pages.description: Place sign templates on a satellite map. Drag to reposition, edit status and mount type.

pages.title: My Account
pages.description: View and update your personal information, contact details, congregation, and password.

pages.title: My Schedule
pages.description: View your personal shift assignments for all convention days.

pages.title: Continue Registration
pages.description: Resume an incomplete registration from where you left off.

pages.title: All Tools
pages.description: Oversight dashboard showing all tools available based on your role and permissions.

pages.title: Campaign Center
pages.description: Send convention invitations via email or SMS. Manage campaigns, templates, and track RSVP responses.

pages.title: Invitation Tracker
pages.description: View sent invitations, filter by campaign or response status, and identify non-responders.

pages.title: Send Reset Link
pages.description: Send password reset or account completion links to volunteers with incomplete registrations.

pages.title: Edit Volunteer
pages.description: View and edit volunteer account details including contact, congregation, and spiritual information.

pages.title: Create Volunteer
pages.description: Manually create a new volunteer account. A temporary password is assigned automatically.

pages.title: Role Management
pages.description: Assign and update volunteer roles. Roles control what each user can see and do across the site.

pages.title: Lessons Learned
pages.description: Submit lessons learned from convention operations. OVERSEER+ can approve and publish entries, generating a PDF report for convention oversight.

pages.title: Notes Report
pages.description: Review intake notes submitted by volunteers during registration. Acknowledge notes, create action items, and track resolutions.

pages.title: Contact Directory
pages.description: Email and phone number for every volunteer with a completed registration.

pages.title: Application Status
pages.description: View all volunteers with their registration status and identify accounts with missing information.

pages.title: Timelines
pages.description: Define convention days, sessions, and event shifts. Mark shifts as invitable and attach locations.

pages.title: Locations
pages.description: Define parking locations and zones for the current year used in building shift assignments.

pages.title: Event Types
pages.description: Manage shift categories used in scheduling — Ingress, Egress, Security, and more.

pages.title: Crew Assignments
pages.description: Assign volunteers to parking crews. Controls which shifts each volunteer is eligible for in the Scheduler.

pages.title: Rendezvous Points
pages.description: View and manage meeting point details for shift assignments. Includes GPS, photo, and floor info sent with shift alerts.

pages.title: Scheduler
pages.description: Assign volunteers to shift slots. Filter by rank or department and enforce role eligibility automatically.

pages.title: Scheduler Report
pages.description: Printable schedule report for a convention day, organized by department, shift, and location. Publish to generate a PDF and notify volunteers.

pages.title: Conflict Grid
pages.description: View a master grid of all volunteer shift assignments to identify scheduling conflicts and coverage gaps.

pages.title: Schedule Analysis Rules
pages.description: Manage standing policy rules injected into the AI schedule analysis. Rules influence how violations are assessed and suggested for resolution.

pages.title: Volunteer Schedule
pages.description: Look up any volunteer's shift assignments across all convention days. Print or send via SMS/email.

pages.title: Shift Alerts
pages.description: Schedule and send SMS shift reminders. Manage burst alerts, rolling T-15 notifications, and the send log.

pages.title: Capacity Alerts
pages.description: Define SMS alert thresholds per location and choose who gets notified when a lot crosses a threshold.

pages.title: Check-In Tool
pages.description: Log volunteer attendance shift by shift. Mark arrivals, add walk-ins, and record notes in real time.

pages.title: Attendance Report
pages.description: View attendance across all shifts for a convention day. See invited, RSVP, attended, and no-show counts.

pages.title: Export to Decently
pages.description: Download a CSV of volunteers not yet exported and mark them as exported in the system.

pages.title: Import from Decently
pages.description: Upload an approved volunteer CSV from Decently. Matches records, sets active status, and flags new entries.

pages.title: Permission Matrix
pages.description: Override default role permissions at runtime. Changes take effect on next login.

pages.title: Oversight Structure
pages.description: Configure the reporting structure displayed on volunteer home pages.

pages.title: System Variables
pages.description: Manage dynamic lists used throughout the application (location types, sub-location labels, and more).

pages.title: Parking Counter
pages.description: Phone-first tally tool for counting cars at your assigned parking location.
